options.content:
Leaf node - monitoring dashboard
export status to central node

targets.rawSql:
WITH
latest_export AS (
  SELECT source_key, status, started_at, error_message
  FROM   heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  ORDER  BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT  1
),
latest_success AS (
  SELECT started_at
  FROM   heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  WHERE  status = 'success'
  ORDER  BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT  1
),
ago AS (
  SELECT
    ts_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ts IS NULL                               THEN '—'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) <    60  THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts)::int || 's ago'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) <  3600  THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) /   60)::int || ' min ago'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) < 86400  THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) / 3600)::int || ' hours ago'
      ELSE                                               (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) / 86400)::int || ' days ago'
    END AS ago_text
  FROM (VALUES
    ('attempt', (SELECT started_at FROM latest_export)),
    ('success', (SELECT started_at FROM latest_success))
  ) t(ts_name, ts)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(le.source_key, '') AS source_key,
  COALESCE(le.status, 'No exports yet') AS last_status,
  (SELECT ago_text FROM ago WHERE ts_name = 'attempt') AS last_attempt_time,
  (SELECT ago_text FROM ago WHERE ts_name = 'success') AS last_success_time
FROM  (SELECT 1) base
LEFT  JOIN latest_export le ON true
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1

options.content:
Last Successful Export
{{last_success_time}}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    started_at AS "time",
    ROUND(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)::numeric, 1) AS "Duration",
    CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS "Success",
    CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS "Failed"
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp AND $__timeTo()::timestamp
    AND $UserIsAdmin = 1
  ORDER BY started_at ASC

SELECT 
  started_at AS "Attempt time",
  status AS "Status",
  COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0) AS "Duration (s)",
  CASE 
    WHEN error_message IS NULL THEN '—' 
    WHEN error_message ~* 'sftp.*login|authentication.*fail|wrong.*password|bad.*password|ssh.*auth' THEN 'SFTP login rejected — check credentials' 
    WHEN error_message ~* 'connection.*refused|timed.?out|network.*unreachable|no.*route' THEN 'Connection failed — check network' 
    WHEN error_message ~* 'no such file|directory.*not.*found' THEN 'Remote path not found' 
    WHEN error_message ~* 'permission.*denied|access.*denied' THEN 'Permission denied — check SFTP access' 
    WHEN error_message ~* 'disk.*full|no space|quota.*exceeded' THEN 'Disk full on central node' 
    ELSE error_message 
  END AS "Failure reason" 
FROM heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log 
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
ORDER BY started_at DESC 
LIMIT 200
